## Code Review Findings
### 🟡 Suggestion / Minor (1)
<details><summary>1 item</summary>

1. `src/sqllens/server.py` lines 458-460: the `query_database` tool description breaks the note line across three indented lines. MCP clients see it with line breaks and indentation, not as the exact single line the answer emits, so a client reading the description cannot match the line exactly. Criterion 12 only asks that the description say the SQL starts with the note line, so no criterion is missed. (raised by 1/4 agents)

</details>
